title: Chapter 2920 - 165: The Mystery of the Holy Beast (Part 3)
content:
Chapter 2920: Chapter 165: The Mystery of the Holy Beast (Part 3)

However, Mo Hua could sense that the Big Tiger seemed to be intentionally slowing down the pace of its breakthrough to clearly present the various changes in its bloodline before him, allowing him to understand the profound mysteries contained therein.

Mo Hua was taken aback, and suddenly understood.

Why the Big Tiger insisted on waiting for him to return before making the breakthrough.

It’s not just because it trusts him, and only feels at ease with him as its protector.

It’s also because the Big Tiger wants him to witness this scene of bloodline transformation, hoping for him to gain some insights.

The Big Tiger is a Monster Beast, occasionally clever, but often quite foolish, and may not comprehend what its bloodline transformation truly signifies.

But instinctively, it can sense that this is the most precious ’inheritance’ within its bloodline.

Therefore, it wants him to also see its bloodline inheritance.

It stayed put, not making the breakthrough, wholeheartedly waiting for his return, with the intention of leaving this ’great fortune’ for him.

Even as it neared the brink of death, it never gave up...

Mo Hua’s gaze trembled, a great emotional surge welled up within him, his nose tingling with a sudden sadness.

"This fool..."

Mo Hua took a deep breath, shelving other thoughts, and focused entirely on being the protector of the Big Tiger.

At the same time, he concentrated intently, observing the changes in the Big Tiger’s bloodline and the process of a Third Grade Tiger Demon’s ’Demon Core’ formation.

He did not waste the Big Tiger’s goodwill.

The scene of Monster Beast forming a core is one that almost all cultivators in the world are unable to witness.

Monster Beasts and humans do not coexist.

Generally, when Monster Beasts encounter cultivators, they react violently and attempt to kill them.

As long as there is even a whiff of cultivator presence, Monster Beasts remain highly alert, making it impossible for them to make breakthroughs—unless the cultivator has already been skinned and stored as their ’reserve food’.

Let alone during the crucial moment when Monster Beasts breakthrough to the Third Grade, forming a Demon Core.

The process of Monster Beast ’core formation’, not even the True Transmission Elder of many Great Sects, who spends a lifetime studying Monster Beast habits, gets the chance to witness.

They can only infer through traces and records from some ancient texts, and simulate based on the Spirit Beast ’core formation’ habits.

To see it in person is utterly impossible.

But now, this peak Second Grade King of Demons, with Holy Beast bloodline, has every step of the Mystic Tiger’s mystic merge of demonic power, blood qi, and bloodline meticulously recorded by Mo Hua, imprinting itself into his memory.

During this process.

Outside the cave, the Third Grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger couldn’t resist its jealousy and anger and continued to charge towards the mountain.

However, every charge it made was blocked by Lugu, leaving it to roar furiously in frustration.

Lugu refrained from delivering a killing blow.

Even though Mo Hua said it could be killed, this Third Grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger was madly furious and fierce, far from the type that could be easily killed.

Thus, he prioritized ’defense’, as long as he could hold off the attacks from these Tiger Demons.

Within the cave, the Big Tiger continued its breakthrough, the Holy Beast’s bloodline aura, exposed in the air, grew increasingly intense.

The Third Grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger grew more and more impatient.

But having been wounded in its Monster Sensing by Mo Hua, coupled with being unable to defeat Lugu, it found itself helpless.

At some unknown moment, atop the mountain, a deafening howl erupted, black and white energies exploded and spread across the mountain.

Uncommon, with traces of sacred aura, Monster Qi soared into the sky.

Amidst the swirling clouds, a mirage of a white Holy Tiger appeared, enveloping the entire mountain.

Core Formation phenomenon.

Furthermore, this was a phenomenon of Monster Beast core formation.

Lugu and the others trembled slightly in their pupils, their hearts struck with awe.

It was the first time in their lives witnessing a phenomenon descending from the heavens during Monster Beast core formation, and witnessing the mirage of a Great Wilderness ’Holy Beast’ was unbelievable.

Soon enough, someone realized:

"This is a divine omen!"

"It is the Shaman’s prayer to the Divine Lord for the Holy Beast!"

With the awe within their hearts dispelled, everyone bowed towards the mountain, reverently proclaiming:

"The Divine Lord is eternal, the Shaman is wise."

"The Holy Beast descends from the heavens, blessing the Great Wilderness!"

Under the intimidation of the celestial phenomenon and the presence of the Holy Beast aura, the oppressive feeling within the bloodline caused more than a dozen originally restless Tiger Demons to instantaneously calm down.

They too bowed, prostrating themselves on the ground.

Even the Third Grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger, under the Holy Beast’s domineering aura, calmed down, bowed its head toward the mountain, not daring to act rashly again.
